title: Metta Sutta, Part 2: The Teachings on Loving Kindness
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The teacher will explore the Metta-sutta, a Buddhist text on loving kindness, by comparing two translations that emphasize different qualities: moral virtues in one translation and wisdom, sincerity, and strength in another. The goal is to understand how these approaches shape our understanding of loving kindness and its practice. By examining the differences between the two translations, the teacher aims to deepen listeners' comprehension of this important Buddhist teaching.
topics: Buddhist concept of "not being submerged by the things of the world"
